AI Age Progression FAQs
1. Will AI age progression show what I will look like when I’m older?
Fotor AI age progression creates a realistic simulation of how you may look at different ages based on your current facial features. It analyzes details such as face shape, skin texture, and aging patterns to generate a natural-looking older version of yourself. However, it is an AI-generated visualization, not an exact prediction of your future appearance.
2.Will my AI aging photo still look like me?
Yes. Fotor AI aging is designed to preserve your recognizable facial features, including face shape, expressions, and unique details. Instead of only adding wrinkles, it creates natural age-related changes while keeping your original identity.
3. What photo size and formats work best for AI age progression?
For the best AI aging results, upload a clear portrait in JPG, JPEG, PNG, or WEBP format. Photos between 256px and 4096px work best, especially images with a visible face and good lighting.
4. Can I choose different ages with Fotor AI age progression?
Yes. Fotor lets you explore different life stages, including Child, Teenager, Adult, Middle Aged, and Elderly. You can customize your aging effect to see how your appearance may change across different ages.
5. Can I process multiple photos with AI age progression?
Currently, Fotor AI age progression is designed for individual portrait transformations. For the most accurate aging results, we recommend processing one clear face photo at a time.
6. Are my photos safe and secure when using AI age progression?
Yes. Fotor takes user privacy seriously. Uploaded photos are used only to provide the requested AI editing service and are handled according to Fotor’s privacy policies. Your images are not used to create personal profiles or identify individuals.
7. Is Fotor AI age progression free to use?
Fotor AI age progression requires credits to generate images. New users do not receive free credits by default, but you can earn credits through the Rewards Center by completing available tasks or daily check-ins. Once you have credits, you can use them to create AI aging photos.
8. Can I download and share my AI aging photos?
Yes. After generating your AI age progression image, you can download your result and share it with friends, family, or social media. Fotor creates high-quality AI aging photos that are easy to save and share.
